I saved the draft email to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his direct message. Nothing has been sent; Hollis or someone else has to send it.

- **Draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate, says Marcus Lindqvist supplied it and asks Hollis not to pass it on without Anselm's or June's OK.
- **Approval:** No approval request was needed. Anselm is the CFO, so his message already approves sharing the rate with Hollis, and Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com.
- **The rate:** I used the $2,101 figure exactly as Anselm wrote it and did not check it against what Marcus originally said. Anselm's direct message with me holds only this one message. The workspace knowledge base (gbrain) refused my search because its connection isn't tied to any member, so it returned nothing. I didn't look in Marcus's own messages because Anselm can't see them. I told Anselm the figure wasn't checked.
